doc.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023

title: Marian McPartland and Wilson's daughter
summary: Wilson's daughter was named after Marian McPartland; they worked closely and were friends.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yeah. I appreciate all your humor and mixed with wisdom, and I understand that your daughter was named after Marian McPartland, is that correct?
We worked a lot together. We were really very close.
Yeah. She came, I invited her to play with my high school band at the time, and boy that is one classy person.
